hero.title: Aiken's history, legends *and a little gossip*
hero.lede: Private driving tours for parties of one to seven, daytime walks through downtown, and evening ghost tours, led by a guide who knows the stories behind the Winter Colony cottages.

sections.title: Tours *and prices*
sections.intro: Tours run first come, first served, so reserve ahead to get the day and time you want. Children 3 to 10 are half price, and under 3 ride free.

items.name: Historic Aiken
items.desc: More than 55 points of interest: winter cottages, churches, downtown and the horse district. The best overview of Aiken's history.

items.name: Aiken's Amazing Cottages
items.desc: The 20-room-plus "cottages" where families like the Astors, Vanderbilts and Whitneys spent their winters.

items.name: Aiken and a Plantation
items.desc: Two plantation homes, admission to Redcliffe Plantation, and round-trip transportation from downtown. Wear comfortable shoes.

items.name: Haunted Aiken
items.desc: An evening walking tour of spirits, stubborn souls and Aiken history, with ghost-hunting tools for the fun of it. Family-friendly; wear walking shoes.

items.name: Downtown by day
items.desc: A daytime walking tour of historic downtown Aiken.

sections.footnote: Prices per person, as listed on the current website.

items.title: Superstar Sojourner
items.text: Each paid guest earns a punch; after nine, the tenth guest rides free, any tour, any time of year.
